# JustSay

> JustSay helps customer-focused businesses collect short voice reviews and understand customer feedback from a live dashboard.

## Public pages

- [Homepage](https://justsay-web.vercel.app/): Overview of JustSay voice review collection and customer feedback insights.

## Product capabilities

- Shareable review links for individual businesses
- Short voice review recording
- Automatic transcription
- Sentiment classification and scoring
- Star rating inference
- Keyword extraction
- Business dashboard with review statistics and recent feedback

## Private areas

The login, dashboard, and business review routes are application workflows and are not intended as public reference pages.
